model: The first mobile restaurant-detail visit covers the screen with a swipe hint. That hint used a full-viewport backdrop-filter plus a second blur on the label, and it stays until the first pointer. The dim scrim remains; the filters do not.

noise.rule: 60 is one full-viewport layer times 60 frames. The label was a second layer. Not a sampled compositor trace. The hint duration depends on the first tap.
